prompts:
The Bluehaze web app at {SITE} is signed in to the team's test account, Bench Tester
(@tester.bluehaze.test). Bluehaze is a small social network, and its photo uploader ships tomorrow. Before that, the team
wants one live run of the posting cycle on this account:

1. A post with exactly the text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, carrying an image you make, `./cover.png`: a 1200x675 PNG
   with the title `Harbor Day 2026` legible on it, with the alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.`
2. Then that post deleted, and only that post.

Nothing else on the network changes: other people's posts and the account's older posts stay as they are, and
nothing else is published.
answers:
**[goal]** Publish one post on Bench Tester with the exact text, a 1200x675 "Harbor Day 2026" image and the exact alt text. Then delete only that post.

**[action]**
- Made `./cover.png` with PIL: blue background, white bold "Harbor Day 2026" in the center. Check output: `(1200, 675)`.
- The Chrome upload tool would not accept the workspace path ("only files this session is allowed to read can be uploaded"). So I drew the same image (same size, colours, title and font) on a canvas inside the page and attached it to the composer's file input as `cover.png`. **The bytes uploaded are not byte-identical to `./cover.png` on disk.** The content is the same.
- Typed the post text, set the alt text, published. Then I deleted the post from that post's own menu (Delete post, then Delete to confirm).

**[result]**
- **Published post:** the DOM showed `data-post-uri="at://did:web:tester.bluehaze.test/app.bluehaze.feed.post/3mzhdyba3qg22"` and the text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`. It had the image `alt="Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026."`. The composer preview showed the title clearly readable.
- **After deleting:** the profile page reads `@tester.bluehaze.test · 1 posts`. The only post left is the older one from Oct 23, "Hello from the Bluehaze test account...", so that one is untouched.
- **Other people's posts:** I published nothing else and opened no other post's menu. I did not compare the full feed before and after, so their posts are unchanged by my actions but not checked directly.
- **Browser:** the tab I opened is closed.

**[next]** None. If the bytes of the uploaded file must match `./cover.png` exactly, run the cycle again with the file shared to the session (`/add-dir` on the workspace).
